# compare actual output against brute implementation on random small topology maybe first implement here by importing
import random, hashlib
from submission.crosscheck.common_utils import NetworkTopology
from submission.crosscheck.dtp import DemocraticTrustPropagationRepair,agreement,trial_agreement

def brute(top, measured,pred, enabled, trials, eps, seed):
 n=len(top.flows); pools=[]
 for f,inds in enumerate(top.flow_reports):
  p=[measured[i] for i in inds if measured[i] is not None]
  if enabled:p.append(min(pred[f],top.capacities[f]))
  pools.append(p)
 fixed=[None]*n; evidence=[[None]*len(e) for e in top.endpoints]
 def refresh():
  for ri, inc in enumerate(top.incident):
   for local,(f,sign,slot) in enumerate(inc):
    if fixed[f] is not None:continue
    vals=[]
    for t in range(trials):
     bal=0
     for g,sg,_ in inc:
      if fixed[g] is not None:v=fixed[g]
      else:
       p=pools[g]
       if not p:v=0
       else:
        a,b=top.flows[g]; w=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f'{seed}:{top.routers[ri]}:{t}:{a}:{b}'.encode()).digest()[:8],'big')
        v=p[w%len(p)]
      bal += sg*v
     # target cancellation: recompute excludes target using target sampled
     p=pools[f]
     if not p: own=0
     else:
      a,b=top.flows[f];w=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f'{seed}:{top.routers[ri]}:{t}:{a}:{b}'.encode()).digest()[:8],'big');own=p[w%len(p)]
     if fixed[f] is not None: own=fixed[f]
     # bal = others + sign*own
     x=own-sign*bal
     vals.append(max(0,min(top.capacities[f],x)))
    evidence[f][slot]=trial_agreement(vals,eps)
 vals=[0]*n; sups=[0]*n
 order=[]
 for z in range(n):
  refresh()
  for f in range(n):
   if fixed[f] is None:
    vals[f],sups[f]=agreement([(x,trials) for x in pools[f]]+[e for e in evidence[f]],eps)
  mx=max((sups[f],-top.flows[f][0],-top.flows[f][1],f) for f in range(n) if fixed[f] is None)
  f=mx[-1];fixed[f]=vals[f];order.append(f)
 refresh()
 return vals,sups,order

for trial in range(1000):
 # topo 3 node chain and externals all
 T={'nodes':[{'id':i,'name':chr(65+i),'external_capacity':30} for i in range(3)],'links':[{'source':0,'target':1,'capacity':20},{'source':1,'target':2,'capacity':20}], 'external_nodes':['A','B','C']}
 top=NetworkTopology(T)
 meas=[None if random.random()<.2 else random.randrange(21) for _ in top.counter_keys]
 dem=[random.randrange(10) for _ in top.demand_pairs]
 pred=top.predict(dem, None) # null but enabled false
 enabled=random.choice([0,1]); routes=None
 if enabled:
  # every pair direct if adjacent? use simple path through chain, construct compiled manually
  routes=[]
  for a,b in top.demand_pairs:
   path=[]; cur=a; step=1 if b>a else -1
   # invalid directed flow? physical all chain, build
   v=a
   while v!=b:
    path.append(top.flow_index[v,v+step] if step==1 else top.flow_index[v,v-1]);v+=step
   routes.append(((tuple(path),1000),))
  pred=top.predict(dem,tuple(routes))
 c=DemocraticTrustPropagationRepair(top,{'trials':random.randrange(1,5),'epsilon':random.randrange(0,1000001),'seed':random.randrange(10)}).repair(meas,pred,enabled)
 bv,bs,bo=brute(top,meas,pred,enabled,c.trials,c.epsilon,c.seed)
 if (c.values,c.supports,c.order)!=(tuple(bv),tuple(bs),tuple(bo)):
  print('BAD',trial,(c.values,c.supports,c.order),(bv,bs,bo), 'trial',c.trials,c.epsilon,c.seed,enabled);break
else:print('all okay')
